name: local-llm
description: Opt-in access to the locally-served coding models on Apple Silicon (Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, Inkling-2-Mini oQ3e, DaisyRose-27B via oMLX, plus Qwen 3.8 27B Splash4 via LM Studio). Bundles the `local-qwen` delegation subagent and the `local-llm` reference skill. Deliberately NOT installed into ~/.claude — it is loaded per-session via `claude subagent` so a plain `claude` never sees it.
